a_side_import.import_method: detached git worktree (no force-push, no history rewrite)
a_side_import.a_evidence_manifest_detail: Experiment A's artifacts live on the PR #15 branch, not on this branch. They were imported through a detached git worktree and re-hashed there; see C0_AB_RECONCILIATION.json / a_artifact_inputs in C0_AB_COMPARISON_V2.json.
a_side_import.a_manifest_validation: FAILED (all 8 entries mismatched the committed blobs)
a_side_import.a_manifest_consequence: Experiment A's MANIFEST.sha256 does not validate against its own committed artifacts. Every A number used in this mission is therefore re-read from the committed JSON bodies, not from the manifest, and A-side values that require the A host (e.g. the EP DLL hash) are labelled single-host-reported and are NOT re-verified here.

integrity_findings.impact: A's evidence chain is not reproducible as published; the numbers survive only because they are internal to the JSON.
integrity_findings.action: recorded, not fixed (frozen evidence); re-derivation documented
